scripts.prepare: bun scripts/setup-git-hooks.ts && sh -c 'if [ -n "$CI" ]; then echo "[prepare] CI -- skipping packaging/electron install (workflows install it explicitly)."; elif [ ! -d packaging/electron ]; then echo "[prepare] no packaging/electron directory -- skipping (container build context or partial checkout)."; elif command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "[prepare] installing packaging/electron deps (needed by the backend backup tests)..."; bun install --frozen-lockfile --cwd packaging/electron; else echo "[prepare] bun not found -- skipping. Backend backup tests will fail until you run: bun install --cwd packaging/electron"; fi'
scripts.generate-locales-if-not-ci: sh -c 'if [ -z "$CI" ]; then bun scripts/generate-locales.ts; else echo "Skipping locales generation in CI"; fi'
scripts.dist: npm run build && cd packaging/electron && npm run dist
scripts.lint: bun scripts/run-parallel.ts --group --kill-others-on-fail "frontend=bun run --filter 'vision-frontend' lint" "deps=bun run lint:deps" "dead=bun run lint:dead" "backend=bun run lint:backend" "projects=bun run lint:projects"
scripts.lint:deps: depcruise --config config/dependency-cruiser.cjs --output-type err apps/frontend/src apps/frontend/scripts apps/frontend/vite.config.ts apps/node-backend/src apps/node-backend/scripts apps/node-backend/tests packages/types/src packages/shared-utils/src packages/shared-utils/tests packaging/electron scripts
scripts.typecheck:packages: tsc -p packages/types/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/shared-utils/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/shared-utils/tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.test:all: bun scripts/run-parallel.ts "backend=bun run --filter 'financial-transaction-manager-node' test" "frontend=bun run test:frontend"
scripts.electron:dev: npm run generate-locales-if-not-ci && bun packaging/electron/build.ts && VISION_RUNTIME_MODE=native VISION_DEVELOPMENT_PROFILE=true packaging/electron/node_modules/.bin/electron packaging/electron
scripts.electron:prod: npm run generate-locales-if-not-ci && bun packaging/electron/build.ts && packaging/electron/node_modules/.bin/electron packaging/electron
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run typecheck:backend && bun run typecheck:packages && bun run typecheck:scripts && bun run typecheck:electron && bun run validate-locales && bun run check-endpoint-matrix && bun run check-legacy-inventory && bun run check-test-only-exports && bun run check:package-boundaries && bun run check:agent-instructions && bun run check:workflow-supply-chain && bun run todo:check && bun run db:lint && bun run test:scripts && bun run test:packages && bun run test && bun run test:frontend && bun run test:electron
